|checkboxAutoTeams=Yes |checkbox2=No |role=Support |issub1=No |istrainee1=No |issub2=No |istrainee2=No |issub3=No |istrainee3=No |issub4=No |istrainee4=No |issub5=No |istrainee5=No |checkbox3=No |stream=https://www.twitch.tv/busiolol |twitter=Busio |instagram=alan_cwalina |tiktok=busiolol |deeplol=https://www.deeplol.gg/pro/Busio |dpmlol=https://dpm.lol/pro/Busio |checkboxSuppressOrgNavbox=No |checkboxSBS=Yes |checkboxTOCR=No |text=He was previously known as '''BusioC'''. |checkboxIsSub=No |checkbox-res=No |checkboxPrev=No }} == Biography == Busio was born in Seattle, Washington. He began playing ''League of Legends'' when he was 7 years old. In 2020, he played in the amateur circuit as a mid laner for [[Polar Ace]], but swapped roles to support when he joined [[100 Thieves Next]] at the beginning of the 2021 season. As a support, Busio quickly rose through the ranks of the [[100 Thieves]] organization. He was promoted to [[100 Thieves Academy]] in the middle of 2021 and was named the most valuable academy prospect during [[NA Academy League/2022 Season/Summer Season|2022 Summer]].[https://twitter.com/PathToLCS/status/1564368922404564992 Path To LCS' Tweet] ''twitter.com'' === 2023 Season === For the 2023 season, Busio was promoted to the 100 Thieves main roster to play alongside returning LCS legend [[Doublelift]]. === 2024 Season === In 2024, Busio achieved greater success after joining [[FlyQuest]] to play alongside rookie [[Massu]]. A 2nd place finish in Spring playoffs birthed FlyQuest appearances at [[2024 Mid-Season Invitational]] and [[Esports World Cup 2024]]. In the Summer split, FlyQuest defeated Team Liquid in the finals for Busio's first LCS championship trophy and first qualification to Worlds. == Trivia == * His father, [[wikipedia:Krzysztof Cwalina|Krzysztof Cwalina]], is a former professional swimmer who represented Poland at the 1992 Summer Olympics in Barcelona.[https://x.com/Busio/status/2049951736270320032 Busio's X Post] ''x.com'' * Reached Challenger when he was 15 years old in Season 9. * Has dual nationality. * His favorite pro player is [[Keria]]. === Individual Awards === * NA Academy Most Valuable Prospect (2022 Summer) * LCS 1st All-Pro Team x1 (2024 Spring) * LCS 3rd All-Pro Team x1 (2024 Summer) {{PlayerStatsTrivia}} == Tournament Results == {{PlayerResults|show=overviewpage}} {{PlayerShowmatchResults|show=overviewpage}} {{PlayerResults1v1|show=overviewpage}} == Media == {{PlayerMedia}} === Images === {{PlayerProfileGallery}} {{PlayerPageEnd}}
